title: P2 worker.enroll: request
description: The operator enrolls a worker: tenant, role, kind, labels; for a toolhost the plugins, placement and machine; for a channel, sink and monitoring adapter the name of the delivery target. There is no owner parameter (DSP-10, IDN-5); with the bot parameter an unbound identity of the same tenant and role is bound (IDN-8).

target.description: Name of the channel, sink or monitoring adapter.

rotate_p2.description: Only for a channel process: issue a new P2 secret of the driver; the previous one is valid until the end of the rotation window (docs/operations.md, "Secret rotation"; D-87 (3)).
